title: Named-test registry file (overview §7.7, gate check G8)
description: One file tests/registry/<TST-ID>--<task-id>.yaml per named test per task. File name must equal <id>--<introduced_by>.yaml.

id.description: Named test ID from overview §6.1, for example TST-LAB-001.

introduced_by.description: Plan task that created this registry file, for example W2-T06.

kind.description: playwright entries are listed but executed only by e2e.yml and W6-T10.

target.description: pytest: <path>::<test name>; vitest: test file path; opa and kyverno: policy test directory; playwright: spec file path.
